newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt food firm posts 4.0 pound yield.
newsitem.headline: Egypt food firm posts 4.0 pound yield.

text.p: Egyptian Starch and Glucose said on Sunday it would give a four pound dividend for each of its 4.6 million shares in the 1995/6 financial year which ended on June 30.
The privatised firm said shareholders could pick up their yield from Banque Misr on 29 December, 1996.
Egyptian Starch and Glucose made net profits of 24.4 million pounds ($7.2 million) in 1995/6, 8.3 percent up on 22.6 million in the previous year.
In June the state sold off more than 2.75 million shares in the company at a fixed price of 35 pounds as part of its privatisation programme.
The state's Holding Company for Food Industries retains a 40.1 percent stake in Egyptian Starch and Glucose.
